title: NoFridayMail environment
description: Describes a deployment environment (one file per environment in deploy/environments/ or deploy/environments.local/). Strictly validated by tools/env-config.js, which adds the consistency rules (a working day that is not blocked, unique names and add-in Ids...).

description.description: Free-text comment (not used by the build).

name.description: Short environment name = file name without .json (lowercase letters, digits, hyphens).

protected.description: true: the deploy script refuses this environment without -ConfirmLab.

displayName.description: Name shown in Outlook and in the admin center, e.g. "NoFridayMail" or "NoFridayMail (Staging)".

addinId.description: Add-in GUID (manifest Id). UNIQUE per environment, which is what lets several environments coexist in one tenant, and STABLE for the whole life of the environment: the same Id means Outlook updates the same add-in, a new Id installs a second add-in for every user. Generate it once with tools/New-NoFridayMailEnvironment.ps1 (or [guid]::NewGuid()) and never change it after users installed the add-in.

version.description: Four-part manifest version (e.g. 1.1.0.0), at least 1.0.0.0. Increase it with every manifest change.

subscriptionId.description: Azure subscription GUID (optional: otherwise the active az subscription is used).

location.description: Azure region of the Static Web Apps resource, e.g. westeurope.

appInsights.description: Name of an Application Insights resource (optional): created if missing and linked to the Static Web App (APPLICATIONINSIGHTS_CONNECTION_STRING setting) so that exceptional-send requests can be found in the traces. Useful with bypass.mfa.

blockedDays.description: Days on which sending is forbidden (0 = Sunday ... 5 = Friday ... 6 = Saturday).

workingDays.description: Working days that are PROPOSED (same numbering). At least one must not be blocked.

slotTimes.description: Times proposed in the task pane (HH:mm), 8 at most.

dayCount.description: Number of days shown in the task pane day row.

bypass.description: Justified exceptional send (optional; absent = disabled). When enabled is true, the task pane offers to send despite the block with a justification, carried in the X-NoFriday-Bypass header. Authorization is checked server-side (Exchange transport rule): see docs/NoFridayMail-Guide.md.

enabled.description: true: enables the exceptional-send section of the task pane and the handling of the header by the OnMessageSend handler.

minLength.description: Minimum length of the justification after cleaning (characters, default 20).

maxLength.description: Maximum length of the justification (characters, default 200).

minWords.description: Minimum number of words of at least 3 letters (default 3; 0 disables the check).

mfa.description: MFA step (optional): the exceptional send requires an identity verified by Entra ID (authentication context, e.g. c1) and a receipt issued by the site API (POST /api/bypass). When required is true, the task pane no longer offers version 1 of the header and the handler accepts version 2 only. See docs/NoFridayMail-Guide.md.

clientId.description: Application (client) ID of the environment app registration: NAA client and API (scope api://<clientId>/access_as_user).

authContext.description: ID of the Entra authentication context protected by the "MFA every time" Conditional Access policy (c1 to c99).

minDistinctChars.description: Minimum number of distinct letters, ignoring case (default 6; 0 disables the check). Rejects "aaaa aaaa aaaa".

defaultLanguage.description: Fallback language when Outlook does not provide the display language.
